## ✅ Checklist

<!-- Tick what the diff proves. Annotate what cannot apply: "(N/A, <reason>)". -->

- [ ] Could this PR be two PRs? If yes, split it first
- [ ] The author has proofread the PR (diff, description and comments) before assigning reviewers
- [ ] Code follows the conventions in `AGENTS.md`, `collaboration/` and `conventions/`

- [ ] No debug code, `print` statements, or commented-out code left behind
- [ ] No compiler warnings introduced
- [ ] No sensitive data (secrets, credentials, tokens) committed
- [ ] Documentation updated if public APIs or architecture decisions changed
- [ ] CI is green
